historical_analysis.combined_sm_rule: mean of ERA5-Land depth-weighted 0-1m SM and GLDAS_CLSM 0-1m SM

drought_definition.flash_rule: onset must decline from >40th toward/below 20th with no less than 5 percentile points per pentad; after below 20th onset ends when decline falls below criterion; event terminates when SM rises above 20th
drought_definition.slow_rule: onset declines from >40th toward/below 20th and includes at least one pentad below the flash decline-rate criterion; after below 20th onset ends when SM begins increasing; event terminates when SM rises above 20th

drought_metrics.onset_speed: (40th percentile - lowest percentile at onset) / onset length

vegetation.growing_season_threshold: minimum multiyear-mean pentad GPP + 30% seasonal amplitude
vegetation.tropical_year_round_condition: minimum GPP > 10 g C m-2 d-1 (peer-review clarification)
vegetation.resilience: mean vegetation anomaly after drought effect minus multiyear growing-season mean

random_forest.feature_sampling_peer_review: one covariate chosen at random from full set for splitting rule
